statement: You receive one line holding a string s of lowercase letters. Print the length of its longest palindromic substring. Treat every position as a centre - each character for odd lengths and each gap between two characters for even lengths, 2n-1 centres in all. Expand outward from each centre while the two end characters match, and keep the widest success seen.

example.why: Both bab and aba have length 3, and no palindromic substring of length 4 exists.

hint: Even-length palindromes hide between characters; expanding only from characters misses bb.
mistake: Trying odd centres alone - on cbbd that answers 1 instead of 2.
